title: MATLAB reproduction package for the national DRASTIC assessment of Albania: representation, identifiability, geometry, inference, and decision
description:
MATLAB reproduction package for the manuscript The national DRASTIC assessment of Albania. Base MATLAB, no toolboxes. One command, run_all, re-derives every statistical, geometric and decision result of the paper from the archived inputs shipped with the repository: the seven recovered national DRASTIC rating rasters of Albania on a common 100 m grid, the archived exact index, and the 62-point national calibration table.

The package computes: the national index and its verification against the archived raster; the attainable profile set with its ranks, spectra and gauge kernel; the threshold hyperplane arrangement, its chamber bound and margins; the max-margin threshold redesign; the hierarchical Bayesian posterior over DRASTIC weights with the 1987 Delphi consensus as prior; the national posterior class-probability field with its draw-pair instability and the margin-probability bridge; the preposterior value of monitoring by aquifer family; and the three manuscript figures.

All random seeds are fixed and determinism is checked rather than asserted: determinism_check.ps1 deletes every result and runs the chain twice from scratch, comparing the SHA256 of the verification file. The same computations also exist in an independent Python implementation that produced the values quoted in the manuscript; the two share input data and model specification but no code, so their agreement is a check on implementation.

The package also carries the revision stages of the companion model manuscript: the preposterior analysis at forty rehearsals per aquifer family with the Monte Carlo error of each value, the chains saved for diagnostics, the split-chain potential scale reduction and effective sample sizes, the cross-validated discrimination of the deployed index against measured nitrate, the cross-check against the locally calibrated Fushe-Kuqe map, and the four figures of that manuscript.
notes: The code in matlab/ is MIT licensed. The data in data/ are derived from the official 2024 national groundwater vulnerability assessment of Albania and from the national groundwater monitoring network reported to the Eionet Central Data Repository; they are released under CC BY 4.0 with the attribution set out in data/README.md.
